text:
marcus: Hey team — CloudScale asked to accelerate onboarding for their Fairbank (north2) marketplace offering. They need 8x A100 reserved capacity, marketplace SKU published, and KMS integration for key wrap. target launch: 2025-11-15. Any immediate blockers?

sandeep: I'll check capacity headroom and cost impact.

julia: quick infra snapshot: north2 shared pools at ~72% usage. 8 A100s look doable but we should request a dedicated reservation and cloud quota. Provider quota turnaround is typically 5-7 business days.

anna: sales/comms note: partner expects a published SKU and co-branded announcement collateral. i'll need pricing draft and commit terms to share with partner marketing.

marcus: CloudScale says they'll use partner-managed KMS with an external wrapping key. they provided a sample IAM/KMS policy that references svc-cloudscale-fairbank@redwood.example.com. tagging @kevin-legal for policy and press checks.

cloudscale-poc: confirming: we'll provide a limited signing endpoint and an integration account for smoke tests. sample KMS policy (they sent):
```
{
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/cloudscale-integration"}, "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"]}
  ]
}
```

kevin-legal: I'll review. two asks: 1) confirm whether keys will be customer-managed HSMs (if so we need an addendum); 2) need partner security questionnaire answers and residency commitments for PII. Also want to see the draft co-announcement language.

julia: ops action: propose internal SKU id rw-north2-8a100-v1. need billing owner, SLA desc, and provisioning window. i'll submit quota request once we have the go-ahead.

sandeep: i'll pull cost-modeling numbers and share a recommended margin. dropping details in #partners-costs and DMing anna.

anna: thanks. i'll put a tentative co-announce on 2025-11-18 (three days after target launch) and start a one-pager for partner marketing.

deploy-bot: playbook created: /playbooks/partnerships/1743228888-cloudscale-fairbank-onboard.md (owners: julia, sandeep, anna, kevin-legal).

julia: submitted quota ticket (provider ticket Q-49217). ETA 6 business days per provider. linked in playbook.

cloudscale-poc: test account creds scheduled to be delivered Tue EOD. we can also expose a limited KMS wrap endpoint for integration smoke tests.

kevin-legal: reviewed partner security pack. requested minor KMS policy changes: scope ARN to the specific keys we provision, and require MFA for key admin. i'll upload redlines to the playbook.

julia: ops checklist update: add canary traffic routing, fallback target eu-west1, and automatic rollback if error rate >2% during canary.

marcus: action summary: julia submit quota (in flight), sandeep pricing, kevin legal signoff on policy + press blurb, anna draft SKU + comms. partner to provide test creds and fringe assets. next sync Fri 09:30 PT.

sandeep: cost numbers posted in #partners-costs. initial price + 20% margin looks fine to me.

cloudscale-poc: uploaded co-branded banner and integration 1-pager to the playbook.

anna: thanks — i'll coordinate announcement cadence with growth and scheduling.

julia: provider approved quota at 1743229380, allocating 8 A100s. updated playbook and routing rules.

marcus: great — proceeding with dry-run 2025-11-12, partner smoke 2025-11-13, soft launch 2025-11-15, public announce 2025-11-18. ping me for any blockers. :thumbsup:
